name: cloudflare-actions-url-forword
description: Redirect Forgejo Actions URLs to a public Forgejo or GitHub

FORGEJO_BASE_URL.description: Required. Enter your public Forgejo root URL, for example `https://forgejo.example.com`. Use `http://` or `https://`, and do not include a path, query, fragment, or trailing slash.

FALLBACK_BASE_URL.description: Optional. The root URL to use when a repository is not found on Forgejo. The default is `https://github.com`.

ACTIONS_CACHE.description: Required KV namespace. Cloudflare creates or binds it during Deploy to Cloudflare. It caches repository discovery results.
